name: Can an old house be demolished and rebuilt as a custom home in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Can an old house be demolished and rebuilt as a custom home in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Can an old house be demolished and rebuilt as a custom home in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many custom home projects in Los Angeles begin with demolishing an existing house and rebuilding from the ground up. This is common when the current structure is outdated, poorly laid out, or not worth remodeling. The process usually includes site evaluation, demolition permits or approvals, utility shutoff coordination, debris hauling, grading, and then new foundation work. In some cases, the existing structure may contain conditions that affect the schedule, such as hazardous materials, undocumented additions, or difficult access for equipment. Homeowners should confirm whether demolition is included in the builder’s scope or handled separately. It is also smart to check whether the lot’s zoning, setbacks, or height restrictions will affect the new design after demolition. A demolition-rebuild can be a strong option when the land is valuable and the existing house is no longer the best use of the site. The key is to budget for the full process, not just the new house itself.
